{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /etc/claude-code/.claude/skills/gh-cli\n\n# GitHub CLI (gh)\n\nWork seamlessly with GitHub from the command line.\n\n## Usage\n\n```\ngh <command> <subcommand> [flags]\n```\n\n## Core Commands\n\n```\n  issue:      Manage issues\n  pr:         Manage pull requests\n  repo:       Create, clone, fork, and view repositories\n  api:        Make an authenticated GitHub API request\n  run:        View details about workflow runs\n```\n\nUse `gh <command> --help` for more information about a command.\n\n---\n\n## gh pr\n\nWork with GitHub pull requests.\n\n```\nUSAGE\n  gh pr <command> [flags]\n\nCORE COMMANDS\n  checkout:   Check out a pull request in git\n  checks:     Show CI status for a single pull request\n  close:      Close a pull request\n  comment:    Create a new pr comment\n  create:     Create a pull request\n  diff:       View changes in a pull request\n  edit:       Edit a pull request\n  list:       List and filter pull requests in this repository\n  merge:      Merge a pull request\n  ready:      Mark a pull request as ready for review\n  reopen:     Reopen a pull request\n  review:     Add a review to a pull request\n  status:     Show status of relevant pull requests\n  view:       View a pull request\n\nFLAGS\n  -R, --repo [HOST/]OWNER/REPO   Select another repository using the [HOST/]OWNER/REPO format\n\nINHERITED FLAGS\n  --help   Show help for command\n\nARGUMENTS\n  A pull request can be supplied as argument in any of the following formats:\n  - by number, e.g. \"123\";\n  - by URL, e.g. \"https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/123\"; or\n  - by the name of its head branch, e.g. \"patch-1\" or \"OWNER:patch-1\".\n\nEXAMPLES\n  $ gh pr checkout 353\n  $ gh pr create --fill\n  $ gh pr view --web\n\nLEARN MORE\n  Use 'gh <command> <subcommand> --help' for more information about a command.\n  Read the manual at https://cli.github.com/manual\n```\n\n---\n\n## gh issue\n\nWork with GitHub issues.\n\n```\nUSAGE\n  gh issue <command> [flags]\n\nCORE COMMANDS\n  close:      Close issue\n  comment:    Create a new issue comment\n  create:     Create a new issue\n  delete:     Delete issue\n  edit:       Edit an issue\n  list:       List and filter issues in this repository\n  reopen:     Reopen issue\n  status:     Show status of relevant issues\n  transfer:   Transfer issue to another repository\n  view:       View an issue\n\nFLAGS\n  -R, --repo [HOST/]OWNER/REPO   Select another repository using the [HOST/]OWNER/REPO format\n\nINHERITED FLAGS\n  --help   Show help for command\n\nARGUMENTS\n  An issue can be supplied as argument in any of the following formats:\n  - by number, e.g. \"123\"; or\n  - by URL, e.g. \"https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/issues/123\".\n\nEXAMPLES\n  $ gh issue list\n  $ gh issue create --label bug\n  $ gh issue view --web\n\nLEARN MORE\n  Use 'gh <command> <subcommand> --help' for more information about a command.\n  Read the manual at https://cli.github.com/manual\n```\n\n---\n\n## gh repo\n\nWork with GitHub repositories.\n\n```\nUSAGE\n  gh repo <command> [flags]\n\nCORE COMMANDS\n  archive:    Archive a repository\n  clone:      Clone a repository locally\n  create:     Create a new repository\n  delete:     Delete a repository\n  edit:       Edit repository settings\n  fork:       Create a fork of a repository\n  list:       List repositories owned by user or organization\n  rename:     Rename a repository\n  sync:       Sync a repository\n  view:       View a repository\n\nINHERITED FLAGS\n  --help   Show help for command\n\nARGUMENTS\n  A repository can be supplied as an argument in any of the following formats:\n  - \"OWNER/REPO\"\n  - by URL, e.g. \"https://github.com/OWNER/REPO\"\n\nEXAMPLES\n  $ gh repo create\n  $ gh repo clone cli/cli\n  $ gh repo view --web\n```\n\n## Search Query Syntax\n\nThe `--search` flag uses GitHub search syntax. Full documentation: https://docs.github.com/en/search-github/getting-started-with-searching-on-github/understanding-the-search-syntax\n\n### Comparison Operators\n\n| Query | Description | Example |\n|-------|-------------|---------|\n| `>n` | Greater than | `stars:>1000` |\n| `>=n` | Greater than or equal | `topics:>=5` |\n| `<n` | Less than | `size:<10000` |\n| `<=n` | Less than or equal | `stars:<=50` |\n\n### Range Queries\n\n| Query | Description | Example |\n|-------|-------------|---------|\n| `n..n` | Between range | `stars:10..50` |\n| `n..*` | Greater than or equal | `stars:10..*` (same as `>=10`) |\n| `*..n` | Less than or equal | `stars:*..10` (same as `<=10`) |\n\n### Date Queries\n\nDate format: `YYYY-MM-DD` (ISO8601). Optional time: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00`\n\n| Query | Example |\n|-------|---------|\n| `>YYYY-MM-DD` | `created:>2024-04-29` — after April 29, 2024 |\n| `>=YYYY-MM-DD` | `created:>=2024-04-01` — on or after April 1, 2024 |\n| `<YYYY-MM-DD` | `pushed:<2024-07-05` — before July 5, 2024 |\n| `<=YYYY-MM-DD` | `created:<=2024-07-04` — on or before July 4, 2024 |\n| `YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD` | `created:2024-04-30..2024-07-04` — date range |\n| `YYYY-MM-DD..*` | `created:2024-04-30..*` — on or after date |\n| `*..YYYY-MM-DD` | `created:*..2024-07-04` — on or before date |\n\n### Exclude Results\n\nPrefix qualifier with `-` to exclude:\n\n| Query | Example |\n|-------|---------|\n| `-QUALIFIER` | `stars:>10 -language:javascript` — exclude JavaScript repos |\n| `NOT` | `hello NOT world` — has \"hello\" but not \"world\" |\n\n### Usernames\n\n| Query | Description |\n|-------|-------------|\n| `author:USERNAME` | Filter by specific user |\n| `author:@me` | Filter by current user |\n| `assignee:@me` | Assigned to current user |\n\n### Queries with Whitespace\n\nUse quotation marks for multi-word values:\n- `label:\"bug fix\"` — label with space\n- `cats NOT \"hello world\"` — exclude phrase\n\n---\n\n## JSON Output\n\nCommon fields for `--json`:\n\n**PR**:\n\n```\nadditions\nassignees\nauthor\nbaseRefName\nbody\nchangedFiles\nclosed\nclosedAt\ncomments\ncommits\ncreatedAt\ndeletions\nfiles\nheadRefName\nheadRepository\nheadRepositoryOwner\nid\nisCrossRepository\nisDraft\nlabels\nmaintainerCanModify\nmergeCommit\nmergeStateStatus\nmergeable\nmergedAt\nmergedBy\nmilestone\nnumber\npotentialMergeCommit\nprojectCards\nreactionGroups\nreviewDecision\nreviewRequests\nreviews\nstate\nstatusCheckRollup\ntitle\nupdatedAt\nurl\n```\n\n**Issue**:\n\n```\nclose\n  comment\n  create\n  delete\n  edit\n  list\n  reopen\n  status\n  transfer\n  view\n```\n"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d2127b88-7688-4d3b-b3f6-63f59ca3b1fa","uuid":"1cb8b5c2-3904-4fc0-a402-fcee2fe82ad2","timestamp":"2026-03-18T05:33:55.379Z","isSynthetic":true}
